errors.daemon_refused: nothing answers at {url}: start the daemon or point OCTOPUS_URL at the one that is running
errors.database_url_required: OCTOPUS_DATABASE_URL is not set and there is no install's deploy/.env here that names a database: run this from the install's directory, or set it to a postgres:// DSN
errors.owner_email_required: -owner-email is required: the workspace row needs an owner
errors.permissions_required: -permissions is required (a list, or a preset: {presets})
errors.workspace_not_found: workspace {id} not found (list them with `thulu workspace list`)
errors.store_does_not_reproduce: the store does not reproduce {path}: do not delete it
errors.no_deployment: no deploy/{marker} found at or above {dir}, and none in the default install directory — run `thulu init` first
errors.data_dir_required: a data directory is required (-data or OCTOPUS_DATA_DIR): attachments live under it
errors.some_objects_not_removed: some objects could not be removed
errors.workspace_ambiguous: this install has several workspaces ({workspaces}); pass -workspace with an id or a slug
errors.no_workspaces: this install has no workspace yet; create one with `thulu workspace create`
errors.import_workspace_missing: the bundle's workspace {id} does not exist in this install: create one with `thulu workspace create` and pass it with -workspace <id or slug>
errors.daemon_unknown_host: the host in {url} does not resolve: check OCTOPUS_URL
errors.daemon_timeout: the daemon at {url} did not answer in time

!! -purge-data deletes the Thulu database, every project worktree, the
!! TLS certificates, deploy/.env (the database password and the credential
!! key) and every snapshot in {backups}.
!! There is no undo: export what you need first (thulu export).

yourself against the cluster (the last two delete the data plane's namespaces
and everything in them):
